A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the renal blood flow is a shunted, nonuniform, pulsatile flow with a high degree of recirculation.
there are at least two distinct pathways in the kidney, one with very short transit times, and one with transit times similar to those found in other tissues.
the kidney is a very efficient organ for the extraction of albumin and that this is accomplished by a mechanism of shunting red cells through a portion of the circulation.

the kidney is a very important organ in maintaining blood flow.
the kidney is an important organ that is involved in the regulation of the hematocrit and the circulating blood volume.
